subject: general
question:
Choose the address that is the same as the one given below.

Sample Address: Room No. 5, Block-B, Hostel 1, IIT Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh - 208016

options.text: Room No. 5, Block B, Hostel 1, IIT Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh - 208016
Room No. 5, Block-B, Hostel 1, IIT Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh - 208016
Room No. 5, Block-B, Hostel I, IIT Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh - 208016
Room No. 6, Block-B, Hostel 1, IIT Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh - 208016

solution:
The address given in the problem is,

Room No. 5, Block-B, Hostel 1, IIT Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh - 208016

Let’s match this address with the given options one by one to find which one is exactly the same.

 
 

 **Option**
 **Address in Option**
 **Given Address**
 **Comment**
 
 

 (1)
 Room No. 5, Block B, Hostel 1, IIT Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh - 208016
 Room No. 5, Block-B, Hostel 1, IIT Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh - 208016
 Missing hyphen in "Block-B" → mismatch
 
 

 (2)
 Room No. 5, Block-B, Hostel 1, IIT Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh - 208016
 Room No. 5, Block-B, Hostel 1, IIT Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh - 208016
 Exact match with the given address
 
 

 (3)
 Room No. 5, Block-B, Hostel I, IIT Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh - 208016
 Room No. 5, Block-B, Hostel 1, IIT Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh - 208016
 "Hostel I" instead of "1" → mismatch
 
 

 (4)
 Room No. 6, Block-B, Hostel 1, IIT Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh - 208016
 Room No. 5, Block-B, Hostel 1, IIT Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh - 208016
 Room number differs (6 instead of 5) → mismatch
 
 

So, the address that is exactly the same as the given address is in option (2).

Hence, the correct option is "**option (2)**".
